ID_H_ANAKIN_TIPS_1: Anakin Skywalker's ultimate ability RETRIBUTION charges up when friendly characters near him are defeated or damaged, as well as when he is injured.
ID_H_ANAKIN_TIPS_2: Anakin Skywalker's PULL DOMINANCE can easily be combined with area of effect abilities from friendly characaters.
ID_H_ANAKIN_TIPS_3: Anakin Skywalker's HEROIC MIGHT can be held down to highly reduce damage and increase its final effect.
ID_H_BB8_ABILITY_SWIFTREACTION_DESC: BB-8 passively increases the cooldown speed of friendly characters around him.
ID_H_BB8_ABILITY_TECHNICALSUPPORT_DESC: BB-8 counts as two units when capturing a point and activates objectives faster.
ID_H_BB8_TIPS_1: BB-8 is extremely agile on the battlefront. Use this edge to zip between multiple hot zones and help your allies.
ID_H_BB8_TIPS_2: BB-8 has several passive abilities. Position yourself on the battlefront to make the most of them.
ID_H_BB8_TIPS_3: Enemies affected by BB-8's RESISTANCE BACKING will get misleading data on their radar.
ID_H_BB9E_ABILITY_BACTASUPPORT_DESC: BB-9E passively regenerates the health of close by allies.
ID_H_BB9E_ABILITY_TECHNICALSUPPORT_DESC: BB-9E counts as two units when capturing a point and activates objectives faster.
ID_H_BB9E_TIPS_1: BB-9E is extremely agile on the battlefront. Use this edge to zip between multiple hot zones and help your allies.
ID_H_BB9E_TIPS_2: BB-9E has several passive abilities. Position yourself on the battlefront to make the most of them.
ID_H_BB9E_TIPS_3: Enemies wielding lightsabers inside BB-9E's SMOKE SCREEN will have a hard time closing in on their targets.
ID_H_DOOKU_TIPS_01: Count Dooku is a menacing opponent up close but is not as powerful against enemies far away or in greater numbers.
ID_H_DOOKU_TIPS_02: Count Dooku has a stronger Dodge Ability than most characters. It recharges faster and can be performed more times in consecutive order.
ID_H_DOOKU_TIPS_03: DUELIST boosts Count Dooku's lightsaber attacks, surprising his enemies with faster and more devastating blows.
ID_H_FINN_TIP_1: Finn's BIG DEAL grants him more damage reduction the more allies are affected.
ID_H_FINN_TIP_2: The EL-16 will continue target enemies until the active time is over.
ID_H_FINN_TIP_3: During UNDERCOVER TEAM, the range affecting enemies and friendlies is different.
ID_H_PHASMA_TIP_1: The shock from Captain Phasma's FIRST ORDER SENTRY is automatic when enemies come in range.
ID_H_PHASMA_TIP_2: Captain Phasma's SONN-BLAS F-11D has two different zoom functionalities: a night vision and a high level zoom.
ID_H_PHASMA_TIP_3: Captain Phasma's SURVIVOR ability can give her a temporary health bonus beyond her maximum value.
ID_H_TIPS_OBIWAN_02: Obi-Wan Kenobi's DEFENSIVE RUSH can be retriggered at any time by pressing the Attack button, unleashing a powerful ligthsaber swing .
ID_H_TIPS_OBIWAN_03: Obi-Wan Kenobi's ALL-OUT PUSH can be released at any moment if time is of the essence.
